scheme_name: Schemes Of H.P. Backward Classes Finance & Develpoment Corporation
other_conditions: Applicants must belong to the notified backward classes.
Annual income must be exactly INR 98,000 for rural residents and less than INR 1,20,000 for urban residents.
benefits_summary: Provides loans up to INR 5 lakh with subsidized interest rates to support the social, educational, and economic upliftment of backward‑class families living below the poverty line.
documents_required: Himachali certificate issued by the executive magistrate
